sections.heading: Proprietary software and reusable IP, matched to your needs
sections.body:
Products are software you can buy independently or combine with Linkfields services. Choose the application, quality, data or security task you need to address.

[Business applications](#digital-transformation) · [ERP and CRM fit](#intelligent-enterprise-platforms) · [Data and insight](#data-ai) · [Security and AI controls](#cyber-security)
sections.secondaryHeading: A reusable starting point for delivery
sections.secondaryBody:
Accelerators are delivery IP applied where appropriate, not five assumed off-the-shelf SaaS products. Their use depends on your data, systems, readiness and agreed scope.

[Prediction and risk](/products-and-accelerators/predictive-analytics-suite) · [Simulation](/products-and-accelerators/digital-twin-suite) · [Workflows](/products-and-accelerators/intelligent-workflow-automation) · [Power BI reporting](/products-and-accelerators/power-bi-ai-ml) · [Delivery assurance](/products-and-accelerators/delivery-accelerators)

sections.heading: Linkfields products
sections.description: Eight products across four portfolios. Linkworks is one product used in both Digital Transformation and Intelligent Enterprise Platforms.

products.name: Linkworks
products.description: Modernise legacy applications with microservices, REST APIs, composable UI and DevSecOps.

products.name: testoriumz
products.description: Replace a fragmented testing-tool estate with test management, low-code automation, AI root-cause analysis and reporting.

products.name: Linkworks
products.description: The same Linkworks product: compose customised ERP, CRM and complex business applications where packaged platforms do not fit.

products.name: textIQ
products.description: Search and find insight across unstructured enterprise content.

products.name: FinSight
products.description: Analyse financial data and produce reports through a conversational workflow.

products.name: EduPilot
products.description: Rapid course creation for education and corporate learning.

products.name: VajraX
products.description: AI-powered exposure validation of the external attack surface.

products.name: VectorX
products.description: Review software security from repository to release.

products.name: AI Governance
products.description: A Linkfields offering built on Portkey + Opik for guardrails, cost visibility and tracing; those tools are not Linkfields-owned.

sections.heading: Buy software independently, or add delivery support
sections.description: Licence and subscription are commercial terms. SaaS is a delivery option, not evidence that every product supports the same deployment.

items.title: Standalone software
items.description: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Confirm the applicable terms for the product you select.
items.bullets:
Licence or subscription basis
Hosting and data residency
Onboarding and support scope

items.title: Optional Linkfields services
items.description: Add implementation, integration and managed support from Linkfields where your requirements call for them. Agree these responsibilities separately from the software purchase.
items.bullets:
Implementation and integration
Quality and security reviews
Operating ownership and handover

items.title: Accelerator-led delivery
items.description: Select reusable IP around the change or decision you need to deliver. Scope includes what is reused, what is adapted and what your team supplies.
items.bullets:
Reusable asset and adaptation boundary
Data and system readiness
Acceptance gates and reuse rights

sections.heading: What to bring to a product evaluation
sections.body:
Start with one use case, the systems involved and the people who will use the result. Ask for a guided walkthrough, supported-estate details and the deployment, security and support information needed for your procurement review.

Explore the evaluation workflows for [Linkworks](/products-and-accelerators/linkworks#how-it-works), [testoriumz](/products-and-accelerators/testoriumz#how-it-works), [VajraX](/products-and-accelerators/vajrax#how-it-works) and [VectorX](/products-and-accelerators/vectorx#how-it-works).
sections.secondaryHeading: Confirm the product and delivery boundary
sections.secondaryBody:
Review current capabilities, documentation and any third-party licence dependencies during the discussion. AI Governance is a Linkfields offering built on Portkey + Opik; clarify the Linkfields layer and third-party terms for your scope.

[Visit testoriumz.com — product website](https://testoriumz.com). For an assisted fit or demo discussion, use the form below.
